description: Source code for a command-line interface (CLI) module implementing an interactive chat system with model selection, conversation management, and streaming responses, using libraries such as click, requests, and rich.

classes.name: Console
classes.description: Rich library class for console output

methods.name: _get_available_models
methods.description: Fetches list of available models from the proxy server

methods.name: _select_model
methods.description: Provides an interactive prompt to select a model from available options

methods.name: chat
methods.description: Main CLI command for interactive chat session with options for model, temperature, max tokens, and system message

methods.name: _show_help
methods.description: Displays help information for chat commands

methods.name: _save_conversation
methods.description: Saves current conversation to a JSON file

methods.name: _load_conversation
methods.description: Loads conversation history from a JSON file

methods.name: _stream_response
methods.description: Streams the model's response and returns the full content
